description: Send an HTTP GET request through the trusted server flow boundary. The URL, headers, and timeout are validated by the handler, and the response and stable failure state are exposed together.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the GET request when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL with a host. Other schemes and hostless URLs are rejected.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Optional request headers. Header names and values are sent as text.

inputs.name: timeout_ms
inputs.description: Request timeout from 100 through 120000 milliseconds.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the request completes, including an HTTP status failure.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when URL, timeout, transport, or response handling fails.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: Returns status code, response body, headers, and transport success state.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the response on a 2xx status or a stable HTTP failure.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the request receives a 2xx response.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing URL, method, timeout, or transport failure.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable HTTP result or failure explanation.

description: Read the numeric status code from an HTTP response and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts status extraction when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose numeric status code should be read.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the status code is read.

outputs.name: status_code
outputs.description: Returns the HTTP status code, or -1 when the response does not contain one.

description: Read the text body from an HTTP response and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts body extraction when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose text body should be read.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the response body is read.

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: Returns the response body as text, or empty text when absent.

description: Read one response header by case-insensitive name and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts header extraction when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose header should be read.

inputs.name: header_name
inputs.description: Header name to match without case sensitivity.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the header value is read.

outputs.name: header_value
outputs.description: Returns the first matching header value, or empty text when absent.

description: Read all response headers as a string-keyed map and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts header extraction when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose headers should be copied.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the response headers are read.

outputs.name: headers
outputs.description: Returns response headers as a string-keyed map, or an empty map when absent.

description: Check whether an HTTP response has a 2xx status and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the success check when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose status should be checked.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the status success check.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when the response status is between 200 and 299.

description: Parse an HTTP response body as JSON and expose whether parsing succeeded. Malformed JSON remains visible through Valid and Error while the Flow continuation is deterministic.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts JSON parsing when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: HTTP response whose body should be parsed as JSON.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the response body has been checked.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: Parsed JSON value, or an empty object when the body is blank or invalid.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the response body is blank or parses as JSON; false for malformed JSON.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Parser failure message, or empty text when the body is valid.

description: Encode string-keyed query parameters using UTF-8 URL encoding and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts query encoding when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: String-keyed values to encode as a query string. Omitted or empty input produces empty text.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after query encoding.

outputs.name: query_string
outputs.description: UTF-8 encoded key-value pairs without a leading question mark.

description: Join a base URL, optional path, and optional encoded query text using stable slash and separator rules.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts URL construction when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: Base URL to receive the optional path and query text.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Optional path appended with one separating slash when needed.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Optional encoded query text appended with ? or & as appropriate.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after URL construction.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Combined URL text produced from the supplied components.

description: Retained only to migrate graphs that used a shared HTTP timeout. New graphs should set the timeout directly on HTTP Request nodes.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the legacy timeout update when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: timeout_ms
inputs.description: Legacy shared timeout from 100 through 120000 milliseconds.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the legacy timeout setting is accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the timeout is outside the supported range.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the legacy shared timeout was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable timeout validation code, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable timeout result or validation explanation.

description: Encode text with UTF-8 URL encoding and continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts URL encoding when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Text to encode as URL-compatible UTF-8 text.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after URL encoding.

outputs.name: encoded_url
outputs.description: UTF-8 URL-encoded text.

description: Decode URL-encoded text with UTF-8 and expose malformed input through Valid and Error while continuing through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts URL decoding when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: URL-encoded text to decode as UTF-8.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after URL decoding is attempted.

outputs.name: decoded_url
outputs.description: Decoded text, or the original text when decoding fails.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: True when the input is valid URL-encoded text.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Decoding failure message, or empty text when the input is valid.
